44561.title: An approved line completes whatever the state of its parts

blocks: 1. Sign in as an Owner or Admin (completion permission).

2. In Settings -> the "Work Orders" tab (left sidebar "Settings", then the "Work Orders" tab), set Require Review Before Completion OFF and Require Tech Story / Mileage / Engine Hours OFF; click "Save Settings".

3. Open an Approved work order with an Approved line carrying three parts in three open states, via top menu "Work Orders" -> the "Work Orders" tab -> open a work order -> its "Lines" tab: one part never ordered (Require Ordering Parts on, no Order clicked), one ordered but not received (Order clicked, Receive not), and one in stock but not picked (an "In stock" part with Pick not clicked). Each part shows its status badge on its row.

blocks: 1. On an approved line with an unordered part (ordering required), press "Complete".
2. On an approved line with an unpicked inventory part (picking required), press "Complete".
3. On an approved line with an ordered-but-unreceived part (receiving required), press "Complete".

44562.title: Other line requirements still apply when their setting is on

blocks: 1. Sign in as an Owner or Admin (completion permission).

2. In Settings -> the "Work Orders" tab (left sidebar "Settings", then the "Work Orders" tab) turn ON the relevant LINE REQUIREMENTS (Require Tech Story / Require Mileage / Require Engine Hours) and Save.

3. Open an Approved line that is missing a required tech story / mileage / engine hours, or carries an unresolved core, via top menu "Work Orders" -> the "Work Orders" tab -> open a work order -> its "Lines" tab.
custom_preconds.text:
1. Sign in as an Owner or Admin (completion permission).
2. In Settings -> the "Work Orders" tab (left sidebar "Settings", then the "Work Orders" tab) turn ON the relevant LINE REQUIREMENTS (Require Tech Story / Require Mileage / Require Engine Hours) and Save.
3. Open an Approved line that is missing a required tech story / mileage / engine hours, or carries an unresolved core, via top menu "Work Orders" -> the "Work Orders" tab -> open a work order -> its "Lines" tab.

blocks: 1. Try to complete a line that is missing a required tech story.
2. Try to complete a line with an unresolved core where receiving is not required.
custom_steps.text:
1. Try to complete a line that is missing a required tech story.
2. Try to complete a line with an unresolved core where receiving is not required.

blocks: 1. The other line-level requirements stay: tech story, mileage, engine hours (each only when its setting is on) and core resolution.
2. Where receiving is not required, an unresolved core is asked before the line completes (such a part may never pass through a receive and the invoice must still be right).
3. Satisfying the last outstanding requirement makes a line completable — it does not complete it by itself.

This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8683 and story SV-9251 (Story 5, Parts no longer block completing a line) and the Simple Flow V2 specification (Confluence page 771391574, revised 8 September 2026), read on 9 September 2026.
Last checked against build v26.35.9-5700a76 on 9/9/2026.

44563.title: A line reaches Complete only through the defined paths

blocks: 1. Sign in as an Owner or Admin (completion permission).

2. Have a completable Approved line, via top menu "Work Orders" -> the "Work Orders" tab -> open a work order -> its "Lines" tab. The paths to try are: the line's own "Complete" button; the bulk action bar "Complete line" after ticking lines; "Create invoice" in the work order's header three-dot (more_vert) menu; and "Clock out and complete" in the clock-out modal (press "Start" then "Stop" on a line).
custom_preconds.text:
1. Sign in as an Owner or Admin (completion permission).
2. Have a completable Approved line, via top menu "Work Orders" -> the "Work Orders" tab -> open a work order -> its "Lines" tab. The paths to try are: the line's own "Complete" button; the bulk action bar "Complete line" after ticking lines; "Create invoice" in the work order's header three-dot (more_vert) menu; and "Clock out and complete" in the clock-out modal (press "Start" then "Stop" on a line).

blocks: 1. Complete a line via the line's own Complete.
2. Via the bulk bar Complete lines / Complete all lines.
3. Via Create invoice.
4. Via the clock-out modal's 'Clock out and complete'.
custom_steps.text:
1. Complete a line via the line's own Complete.
2. Via the bulk bar Complete lines / Complete all lines.
3. Via Create invoice.
4. Via the clock-out modal's 'Clock out and complete'.

blocks: 1. A line reaches Complete only through: Complete on the line; Complete lines / Complete all lines in the bulk action bar; Create invoice (which closes the work order's Approved lines as a consequence of invoicing); and Clock out and complete in the clock-out modal.
2. Nothing else completes a line - no timer and no background job.
3. A line in Needs Approval cannot be completed by any path; it must be Approved first, on the line or in the bulk action bar. Nothing approves a line on the way to completing it.
4. Complete lines counts only Approved lines, and Create invoice is refused while any line is still in Needs Approval.
5. Mark as reviewed is not on the list: it becomes available only once every line is already complete, so there is never an open line for it to close.

This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8683 and story SV-9251 (Story 5, Parts no longer block completing a line) and the Simple Flow V2 specification (Confluence page 771391574, revised 8 September 2026), read on 8 September 2026.
Last checked against build v26.35.9-5700a76 on 9/9/2026.

2. Review may be on or off (set in Settings -> the "Work Orders" tab (left sidebar "Settings", then the "Work Orders" tab) -> Require Review Before Completion).

44565.title: Complete is never disabled for a parts reason; reopen returns line to Approved

blocks: 1. Sign in as an Owner or Admin (completion permission).

2. Have an Approved line with outstanding parts and, separately, a completed line, via top menu "Work Orders" -> the "Work Orders" tab -> open a work order -> its "Lines" tab. A completed line offers a "Reopen" control on its row.
3. For the Technician check: use the TECH@shopview.com login in Tech View (never change the Admin role).

1. Sign in as an Owner or Admin (completion permission).
2. Have an Approved line with outstanding parts and, separately, a completed line, via top menu "Work Orders" -> the "Work Orders" tab -> open a work order -> its "Lines" tab. A completed line offers a "Reopen" control on its row.
3. For the Technician check: use the TECH@shopview.com login in Tech View (never change the Admin role).

blocks: 1. Look at Complete on an approved line that has outstanding parts.
2. Reopen a completed line and check its status and parts.
3. As a Technician in Tech View, try to complete a line.

blocks: 1. Complete is never disabled for a parts reason, anywhere.
